actionConfiguration.body: SELECT p.status, p.barcodes, p.vendor, p.title, CASE WHEN p.variant = 'Default Title' THEN '' ELSE p.variant END AS variant, CONCAT(p.content_amount, ' ', p.content_unit) AS content, p.quantity, p.inventory_policy AS policy, s.supplier_quantity FROM public."products" p INNER JOIN ( SELECT barcode, CONCAT( 'Gesamt: ', SUM(quantity), ', ', STRING_AGG( CONCAT( '', supplier, ': ', quantity ), ', ' ORDER BY supplier ) ) AS supplier_quantity FROM ( SELECT barcode, supplier, MAX(quantity) AS quantity FROM public."supplier_inventory" WHERE barcode IS NOT NULL AND barcode <> '' GROUP BY barcode, supplier ) x GROUP BY barcode ) s ON s.barcode = ANY(p.barcodes) WHERE ( '{{SelectStatus.selectedOptionValue}}' = '' OR p.status = '{{SelectStatus.selectedOptionValue}}' ) AND ( '{{SelectVendor.selectedOptionValue}}' = '' OR p.vendor = '{{SelectVendor.selectedOptionValue}}' ) AND ( '{{SelectCategory.selectedOptionValue}}' = '' OR p.category = '{{SelectCategory.selectedOptionValue}}' ) AND ( '{{SelectPolicy.selectedOptionValue}}' = '' OR p.inventory_policy = '{{SelectPolicy.selectedOptionValue}}' ) ORDER BY p.vendor;
